body_text:
Hi! Thank you for registering for the Robotics @APEX trials, we're really
excited to have you guys! At the bottom is a google form, please complete
it latest by 15 January, Tuesday, 3pm.
Your trial date is on 25 Jan, Friday from 2.30pm to 6.30pm. Please wait
outside the Robotics room (Level 3 Block C) at the big staircase (below the
sec 1 classes) by 2.30pm

Thank you !

CLICK ME!
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScYryeXvJvojZhTYJZONNCQJDOZ-tSJKOBNiY2zk0KkUekp3w/viewform?usp=sf_link>
-- 
Ean Kai Lew
EXCO member of Robotics @APEX
